modules.phonology-induction.text.5e47e4d: Edit, save or revert tone categories and initials/finals on this page. Ctrl/⌘ and Shift multiselection and drag reordering are supported. Merging affects classifications while retaining original transcriptions and notes. Save draft at the top stores current edits locally.
modules.phonology-induction.text.2f9ebdd: Step 4 previews initial-to-final, final-to-initial and two-dimensional tables, with search across all records. Both DOCX previews show two-column statistics, representative characters, centered category headings and compact text. Confirmation stays below the table, which shrinks to fit the window; actual DOCX pagination depends on the exported file. Generated previews use that run's settings; regenerate after changes.
modules.phonology-induction.text.17cf0b1: Parser m14/2 corrects tie-bar and Unicode-equivalence handling and accepts trailing ordinary, full-width or superscript tone digits. Isolated consonants follow the selected policy. Multisyllabic or unknown forms need manual review. Limits: 2 MB, 10,000 valid records and 20,000 matrix cells. Corrupt files, formulas and over-budget inputs are rejected explicitly. IPA uses Doulos SIL; external DOCX/XLSX readers need that font.
